$Comment: Christmas's Present Thieves (the role Christmas_Present_Thief), the Trorks in Santa hats who robbed his sleigh. The Nice List's Kills table (ZiggfreedCommon/Reputations/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Nice_List.json) pays favor for each one put down. No reputation group names this group, so it changes nothing about how they treat a player. Add a role id here, written *<id>, and its kills count too. The game's own Trorks pay less, through their own group (Christmas_Game_Trorks) and Kills row. Each of this pack's role ids is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role, while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
